items: First Telugu journal after independence: ==**Jaya Bharat**==
Krishna Patrika office: ==meeting point for freedom fighters==
Andhra Patrika began a **weekly**; promoted **Gandhian** ideas

boxes.title: Journals: more
items: Veeresalingam also: **Hasyasanjivani (1876)**, Satyasamvardhini (**1891**), **Zenana Patrika (1894)**, Satyavadini (**1905**); own press from **1876**

boxes.title: Separate-Andhra demand: more
items: Telugu papers demanded a separate state from ==**1911**==
**Desabhimani**: write on Andhra affairs, not world politics
Supporters: Andhra Patrika, Desamata, **Darbar**; outside: **The Modern Review**, Hindusthan Review, London Review of Reviews
Vernacular Press Act = "**Gagging Act**"; papers also gave rise to ==reading rooms and libraries==
